metadataCorrections.title: The Ark Captured and Returned
metadataCorrections.before: Two cows draw a wooden cart carrying a chest toward people in barley fields.
metadataCorrections.after: Two cows draw a wooden cart carrying a chest toward people harvesting wheat.
metadataCorrections.basis: 1 Samuel 6:13, included KJV/ASV/WEB all specify wheat harvest.

placements.title: Hannah and the Birth of Samuel
placements.alt: Hannah brings young Samuel to the elderly priest Eli at a sanctuary doorway.
placements.review: Hannah, young Samuel and elderly Eli at dedication; grounded light and plausible hands/arms. No Elkanah identity inferred.

placements.alt: Imagined scene: A clay jug and folded linen rest beside a shaded sanctuary doorway at Shiloh.
placements.review: Sanctuary jug and folded linen; a contextual opener. Later call scene retains child Samuel with short dense curls and Eli resting; covered anatomy and distant face limit detail.

placements.title: Eli's Sons and Samuel's Call
placements.alt: Samuel sits awake on a woven mat beside a small lamp while Eli rests nearby.
placements.review: Sanctuary jug and folded linen; a contextual opener. Later call scene retains child Samuel with short dense curls and Eli resting; covered anatomy and distant face limit detail.

placements.alt: Imagined scene: A clay oil lamp burns beside an empty woven sleeping mat in a sanctuary room.
placements.review: Empty mat and lamp fit Samuel’s call; sanctuary setting remains an imagined reconstruction.

placements.title: The Ark Captured and Returned
placements.alt: Two cows draw a wooden cart carrying a chest toward people harvesting wheat.
placements.review: Ark return within the broader capture/return Story; two yoked cows, cart and harvesters. Side figure holds a staff, with no visible driving reins; interpreted as a receiving harvester at arrival (6:13–14), not a driver during the journey. Correct wheat alt text to match all three editions.

placements.alt: Imagined scene: A broken stone idol lies on temple steps, with its head and hands on the threshold.
placements.review: Broken stone idol with detached stone head and hands fits 5:4; carved objects are deliberately broken, not malformed human anatomy.

placements.alt: Imagined scene: A road passes a large stone beside a wheat field near Beth-shemesh.
placements.review: Harvested field, road and large stone fit 6:13–15; wheat in metadata already correct.

placements.alt: Imagined scene: A closed wooden door faces a quiet courtyard at a hilltop house.
placements.review: Empty house courtyard v2 contextualizes Kiriath Jearim; later Samuel/Ebenezer gathering retained. Samuel’s gray curls, nose and dark mantle match elder chain; no exact numeric age inferred.

placements.title: Samuel Judges Israel
placements.alt: Samuel addresses gathered families beside a standing stone as clouds clear.
placements.review: Empty house courtyard v2 contextualizes Kiriath Jearim; later Samuel/Ebenezer gathering retained. Samuel’s gray curls, nose and dark mantle match elder chain; no exact numeric age inferred.

placements.title: Israel Demands a King
placements.alt: Village elders speak with Samuel in a shaded stone courtyard.
placements.review: Samuel hears elders; same gray curly hair, beard, complexion and facial profile. Seated and gesturing hands have no clear defect.

placements.alt: Imagined scene: Two donkeys graze among olive trees and stone terraces in the hill country.
placements.review: Lost-donkey context; ears, legs and hooves coherent; no new human identity.

placements.alt: Imagined scene: A frame drum, lyre and pipe rest on a stone ledge above a hill path.
placements.review: Lyre, frame drum and pipe fit prophetic musicians; contextual still life omits people.

placements.alt: Imagined scene: The walls of Jabesh-gilead overlook a quiet valley at dawn.
placements.review: Walled Jabesh-gilead setting; no unsupported identifiable people.

placements.alt: Imagined scene: Rain falls from dark clouds over wheat fields near Gilgal.
placements.review: Storm over wheat fields fits 12:17–18; no human anatomy.

placements.title: Saul Rejected
placements.alt: Saul reaches toward Samuel’s torn cloak as the two men stand apart.
placements.review: Broad Saul Rejected Story opens its multi-chapter arc; torn cloak depicts 15:27. Samuel and Saul retain recognizable profiles; grips and limbs coherent.

placements.alt: Imagined scene: A narrow rocky pass runs between two steep limestone crags near Michmash.
placements.review: Rocky pass fits the crags near Michmash; imagined geography, not a site photograph.

placements.alt: Imagined scene: Sheep and cattle graze on rocky green pasture.
placements.review: Sheep/cattle fit spared livestock; visible calves/lambs, ears, limbs and hooves have no clear defect.

placements.title: David Anointed
placements.alt: Samuel anoints young David while Jesse and his sons look on.
placements.review: Samuel anoints youthful David among family; gray-haired elder remains recognizable, young David’s curls/profile match chapter 18. Partial family attendance does not enumerate all brothers; no brother is assigned Saul’s identity.

placements.title: David and Goliath
placements.alt: David gathers smooth stones by a stream as an armored man waits across the valley.
placements.review: Youthful David with sling/stones and distant armored Goliath; face mostly hidden, curls/build compatible with chapter 16/18. Hands, knees, feet and sling grip coherent; distant soldier detail limited.

placements.title: Saul's Jealousy and David's Flight
placements.alt: Jonathan gives David a folded robe and belt in a quiet field.
placements.review: Jonathan gives robe to David; youth’s face/curls/build match anointing. Jonathan’s longer curls/beard and blue mantle distinguish him; hands and folded cloth coherent.

placements.alt: Imagined scene: A rope hangs from an open upper window into an empty lane at night.
placements.review: Open upper window and escape rope fit 19:12; empty scene preserves coverage without inventing Michal’s portrait.

placements.alt: Imagined scene: Three arrows lie in the grass beside a large stone in an empty field.
placements.review: Three arrows by a stone fit 20:19–22; empty setting avoids invented figures.

placements.alt: Imagined scene: Twelve round loaves rest on linen atop a wooden table in a sanctuary room.
placements.review: Twelve sanctuary loaves fit showbread context; no people.

placements.title: David in the Wilderness
placements.alt: Abigail speaks with David beside donkeys carrying baskets of food.
placements.review: Broad wilderness Story opens here and previews Abigail’s chapter-25 encounter; adult David retains facial structure/curls, plausibly older with short beard and stronger build. Abigail and servants have coherent visible hands/limbs; conversation can follow her initial bow (25:32–35).

placements.alt: Imagined scene: A sheltered grove stands among rocks in the wilderness of Ziph.
placements.review: Sheltered grove in Ziph fits 23:15–18; no people.

placements.alt: Imagined scene: A cave overlooks a steep ravine and springs near En-gedi.
placements.review: Cave/ravine/springs evoke En-gedi; not an asserted archaeological identification.

placements.alt: Imagined scene: Baskets of bread, dried fruit and grain stand beside two laden donkeys.
placements.review: Bread, raisins/figs and grain with laden donkeys fit Abigail’s provisions; ears, legs/hooves coherent. Not a literal count of her full gift.

placements.alt: Imagined scene: A spear stands in the ground beside a clay water jug under moonlight.
placements.review: Spear and jug fit night-camp objects in 26:7–12; quiet contextual scene omits camp figures.

placements.alt: Imagined scene: Stone and mudbrick homes surround a quiet courtyard at Ziklag.
placements.review: Quiet Ziklag homes fit the settlement before burning; imagined architecture.

placements.title: Saul and the Medium at Endor; Saul's Death
placements.alt: Saul and two companions consult an older woman in a lamplit room.
placements.review: Approved Endor v2 retained; disguised Saul has no circlet, hood and familiar curls/nose/beard. Woman and two companions remain recognizable; visible hands/arms coherent.

placements.alt: Imagined scene: Distant tents line a plain near Aphek, with a spring in the foreground.
placements.review: Distant camp and spring fit Aphek context; no unsupported faces/uniforms.

placements.alt: Imagined scene: Charred roof beams and fading smoke mark empty homes at Ziklag.
placements.review: Burned homes and charred roof beams fit Ziklag; no invented casualties depicted.

placements.alt: Imagined scene: The grassy slopes of Mount Gilboa overlook a broad valley at dawn.
placements.review: Mount Gilboa landscape contextualizes the battle without inventing anatomy/casualty detail.
